info.title: SLNX-validator
info.description: Validates .slnx solution files for issues that Visual Studio and MSBuild silently ignore, including XSD schema violations, missing solution folder files, and wildcard misuse. Supports single files, folders, and glob patterns.

options.name: --sonarqube-report-file
options.description: Write a SonarQube generic issue report to the specified file path.

options.name: --sarif-report-file
options.description: Write a SARIF 2.1.0 report to the specified file path.

options.name: --continue-on-error
options.description: Continue and exit with code 0 even when validation errors are found. [default: False]

options.name: --required-files
options.description: Semicolon-separated glob patterns for files that must exist on disk and be referenced as <File> elements in the solution.

options.name: --blocker
options.description: Comma-separated codes (or * for all) to treat as BLOCKER severity (causes exit code 1).

options.name: --critical
options.description: Comma-separated codes (or * for all) to treat as CRITICAL severity (causes exit code 1).

options.name: --major
options.description: Comma-separated codes (or * for all) to treat as MAJOR severity (causes exit code 1).

options.name: --minor
options.description: Comma-separated codes (or * for all) to treat as MINOR severity (shown, but does not cause exit code 1).

options.name: --info
options.description: Comma-separated codes (or * for all) to treat as INFO severity (shown, but does not cause exit code 1).

options.name: --ignore
options.description: Comma-separated codes (or * for all) to suppress entirely (not shown, not in SonarQube report).

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description: Path to a .slnx file, directory, glob pattern (e.g. src/*.slnx), or comma-separated combination.
